$Comment: Dunewalker Ashkar, the Howling Sands quest giver, standing beside an Outlander hunter camp.
Anchor.Structure attaches the placement to a worldgen spawn marker, so Ashkar lands at the first
camp the world generates and streams in rather than at fixed coordinates. MarkerIds is an exact,
case-insensitive allow-list; run /mmonpc structures in game to see the marker ids a world has
actually loaded before authoring one. The allow-list is FAIL-CLOSED, so a typo leaves Ashkar
absent rather than standing beside every marker in the world.
Limits: one per world, and every matching marker is used. Raise MaxPerWorld to stand one at
Identity carries no Role, which opts the placement into a generated one: the base role is cloned
with the Appearance, nameplate key and press-F hint key below, so the pack ships no role JSON.
Identity.NpcId is the character id everything else binds to: the pack's quests name it as
their npcViewId, the dialogue destination below carries it, and a talk step credits against
it. Omit it and the placement answers to its own file id instead.
Press F opens Ashkar's dialogue, authored as a ui_target rather than as Interact.Dialogue so the
npc id travels with it. That id is what the dialogue's own 'npcquests:@self' options resolve
against and what puts the character's name in the header; it is also what the pack's quests bind
as their npcViewId, and what the campaign's earlier 'go and meet Ashkar' step reports back to.
Name: Guide_Sands
